annotations.title: Wathan RPE Load, Barbell Plates & Karvonen Zone 2 Calculator

description: Public calculator (NO token needed): convert a reference set (weight x reps @ RPE) into piecewise Wathan e1RM, Zourdos RIR/RPE working weight (accounting for bodyweight on pull_up/chin_up/dip), exact gym barbell plate pairs per side, and Tanaka + Karvonen Heart Rate Reserve Zone 2 bpm (eliminating the 16–23 bpm error of 220-Age).

max_hr.description: Optional measured HRmax (defaults to Tanaka 208 - 0.7 * age).

ref_weight_kg.description: Reference set load in kg (ADDED belt load for pull_up, chin_up, dip).

name: plates_zone2
